name: The Red Marker
description: Find the red marker hidden somewhere in the building and record the symbol beside it.

name: Three Room Sequence
description: Visit the three marked rooms and determine the order from the physical clues.

name: The Missing Key
description: Find the missing key near the marked area and bring its number back to the survivor team.

name: The Blue Symbol
description: Locate the blue symbol and enter its shape order from left to right.

name: The Medical Note
description: Find the medical note and deliver its instruction to another survivor in the building.

name: The Stalker Trail
description: Find the clue left along the Stalker's trail and bring its marked number to the survivor team.
